VIVHITE_KEYWORD_LIFE_CALCULATION.title: Life Calculation
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_LIFE_CALCULATION.descrip: If your current HP is equal to or below the stated value, trigger the effect that follows.
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_MARGIN.title: Margin
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_MARGIN.description: When you would lose HP, consume 1 Margin to prevent 1 HP loss. Margin lasts until the end of combat.
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_DIMENSION_UP.title: Dimension Up
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_DIMENSION_UP.description: Increase a card's Dimension by 1 for this combat. Its Dimension-scaled values increase accordingly.
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_DRAIN.title: Drain
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_DRAIN.description: Heal HP equal to unblocked attack damage dealt, up to the stated amount.
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_LETHAL.title: Lethal
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_LETHAL.description: Trigger the effect that follows if this card's attack reduces its target to 0 HP.
